so I've been helping out, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It's gone... It's not here either...!
My precious notebook with the winning formula!"

text_block_list.text: Normally?! Normally it's in my pocket—...!

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... so it was here.
...Seems fatigue is finally clouding my mind.

This uncharacteristic mistake seems to stem from recent fatigue.
Perhaps I should reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
